svg.text: Sienci AltMill + SLB-EXT closed-loop control → SmoothieBox exterior connection study
Proposed exterior terminals → dotted function candidates or explicit OPEN boundaries; no installed harness claim

g.title: G01: explicit design-schematic function guess to Closed-loop motor driver inputs · X / Y1 / Y2 / Z / optional A position X:S+ (X motor driver · step/pulse + differential input). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: SmoothieBox X STEP has a plausible motion-function match to the X motor driver differential step/pulse positive input. SmoothieBox is single-ended and the Sienci motor-driver interface is differential, so this is not a direct wire. Interface: A compatible differential line-driver/buffer channel is required between the SmoothieBox single-ended output and the motor driver differential input. Adapter model, polarity, isolation and logic levels are not selected. Checks: Disconnect and isolate the SLB-EXT controller signal outputs; do not parallel two controllers.; Identify the fitted motor/driver revision and verify the actual STEP/PULSE or DIR differential terminals and mating orientation.; Select a line-driver interface compatible with SmoothieBox output voltage, driver input current, differential polarity, pulse timing and isolation.; Verify machine axis assignment and firmware direction/step configuration before powering the motor stage.; Treat A as optional; verify an A-axis and independent driver are actually installed before using this route.

G02: explicit design-schematic function guess to Closed-loop motor driver inputs · X / Y1 / Y2 / Z / optional A position X:D+ (X motor driver · direction + differential input). svg.text: DOTTED VIOLET = FUNCTION GUESS ONLY. Paths start at the actual drawn exterior screw and end at the named machine contact. No installed continuity or direct cable is established.
FAN-OUT — a tagged guess branches one SmoothieBox signal to multiple named inputs. It is not independent control; use separate suitable buffers and verify total input load before wiring.

OPEN / hollow contact = no SmoothieBox route selected in this study. This does not mean an electrically open circuit, unused pin or NC in the source. Source-empty, unlisted and untranscribed roles remain distinct in their labels.

REFERENCE ONLY = a named source revision, not the installed machine. Reference contacts stay OPEN unless an individually cited dotted function guess is shown. Named hardware with no contact map has an OPEN boundary, not invented '?'

Paths may cross without joining; pale crossing clearance means NO JUNCTION. Multiple guesses from one screw are alternatives unless each shares an explicit FAN-OUT tag. A tagged fan-out still needs separate buffers and load validation.

Exterior label colors: black = circuit GND; red = 3.3 V; orange = 5 V; yellow/gold = load/control feed; blue/violet/green = STEP/DIR/ENABLE. Dotted violet is an evidence state, not a reported cable color. Protective earth is not circuit

DB25, DB44 and 15-contact D-sub housings are outside SmoothieBox. Contact strips preserve source order, not physical pin-row geometry. USB device, USB host, Ethernet and microSD are separate service ports.
RESEARCH DIAGRAM — NOT QUALIFIED FOR PHYSICAL WIRING. Confirm the actual carrier, machine revision, mating view, electrical interface, protection, returns and safety design before construction.
